deletionPolicy: No deletion, move, rename, untracking or history rewrite is authorized.
staleReferencesCorrected: README active deployment/origin and historical evidence labels
Owner runbook existing project/production origin/Preview environment note and production promotion semantics
gitignore: Future local .cache/.eslintcache/tsbuildinfo/editor/*.tmp only; no tracked file untracked
deadCode: Strict noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters and ESLint pass. Unused exported APIs/legacy migration stores are preserved; no exhaustive reachability proof or unsafe deletion is claimed.
duplicates: Owning CSV/backup validators intentionally retained for compatibility; no aesthetic refactor
historicalPolicy: Existing phase/spec/generated schemas/reports/screenshots remain in place; earlier reports certify their own recorded commits.
markerScanScope: Final staged inventory, including generated report references; no runtime review items. Candidate individual marker records are preserved without recursively embedding report mentions.
